description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_EShopOrdering" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/eshop-ordering">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_LoginRequest" name="Login request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_LoginResult" name="Login result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_AddressPaymentCompleted" name="Address and payment completed"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_EShopOrdering">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_EShopSystem" name="E-Shop System" processRef="Process_EShopSystem"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginRequest" name="Login request" sourceRef="T_EnterCredentials" targetRef="SE_LoginRequest" messageRef="Msg_LoginRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginResult" name="Login result" sourceRef="T_CheckCredentials" targetRef="IC_LoginConfirmation" messageRef="Msg_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted" sourceRef="T_SubmitOrder" targetRef="SE_OrderSubmitted" messageRef="Msg_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentData" name="Payment data" sourceRef="T_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="Participant_Bank" messageRef="Msg_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="IC_PaymentConfirmed" messageRef="Msg_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AddressPaymentCompleted" name="Address and payment completed" sourceRef="T_SendCompletion" targetRef="SE_AddressPaymentDone" messageRef="Msg_AddressPaymentCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="SC_Start" name="Customer starts login"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_EnterCredentials" name="Enter login credentials"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IC_LoginConfirmation" name="Login confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginConfirmation" messageRef="Msg_LoginResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_LoginResult" name="Login successful?" default="F_LoginFailed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ShoppingStopped" name="Shopping experience stopped"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_SelectProduct" name="Select product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_ProductsCheck" name="All products selected?" default="F_ProductsNotAllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="T_SubmitOrder" name="Submit order" messageRef="Msg_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_EnterPaymentData" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_WaitSplit" name="Split while waiting for payment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IC_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmed by bank">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentConfirmed" messageRef="Msg_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_EnterShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_BillingSplit" name="Billing address differs from shipping address?" default="F_BillingSameAsShipping"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_AddressMerge" name="Address entry done"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_WaitJoin" name="Payment and address done"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="T_SendCompletion" name="Send payment and address completion" messageRef="Msg_AddressPaymentCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerDone" name="Customer part finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C1" sourceRef="SC_Start" targetRef="T_EnterCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C2" sourceRef="T_EnterCredentials" targetRef="IC_LoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C3" sourceRef="IC_LoginConfirmation" targetRef="GW_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_LoginSuccess" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_LoginResult" targetRef="T_SelectProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Login successful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_LoginFailed" name="No" sourceRef="GW_LoginResult" targetRef="End_ShoppingStopped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C4" sourceRef="T_SelectProduct" targetRef="T_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C5" sourceRef="T_AddToCart" targetRef="T_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C6" sourceRef="T_SaveProduct" targetRef="GW_ProductsCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_AllSelected" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_ProductsCheck" targetRef="T_SubmitOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>All products selected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_ProductsNotAllSelected" name="No" sourceRef="GW_ProductsCheck" targetRef="T_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C7" sourceRef="T_SubmitOrder" targetRef="T_EnterPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C8" sourceRef="T_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="GW_WaitSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C9" sourceRef="GW_WaitSplit" targetRef="IC_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C10" sourceRef="GW_WaitSplit" targetRef="T_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C11" sourceRef="T_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="GW_BillingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_BillingDiffers" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_BillingSplit" targetRef="T_EnterBillingAddress">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Billing address differs from shipping address</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_BillingSameAsShipping" name="No" sourceRef="GW_BillingSplit" targetRef="GW_AddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C12" sourceRef="T_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="GW_AddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C13" sourceRef="GW_AddressMerge" targetRef="GW_WaitJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C14" sourceRef="IC_PaymentConfirmed" targetRef="GW_WaitJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C15" sourceRef="GW_WaitJoin" targetRef="T_SendCompletion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C16" sourceRef="T_SendCompletion" targetRef="End_CustomerDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EShopSystem" name="E-Shop System" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="SE_LoginRequest" name="Login request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginRequest" messageRef="Msg_LoginRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="T_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginChecked" name="Login checked"/>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="SE_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderSubmitted" messageRef="Msg_OrderSubmitted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="T_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_PrepSplit" name="Prepare payment and shipment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="T_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PaymentPrepared" name="Payment prepared"/>
    <bpmn:task id="T_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ShipmentPrepared" name="Shipment prepared"/>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="SE_AddressPaymentDone" name="Address and payment completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AddressPaymentDone" messageRef="Msg_AddressPaymentCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="T_CompleteOrder" name="Complete order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_S1" sourceRef="SE_LoginRequest" targetRef="T_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_S2" sourceRef="T_CheckCredentials" targetRef="End_LoginChecked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_S3" sourceRef="SE_OrderSubmitted" targetRef="T_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_S4" sourceRef="T_FinishOrder" targetRef="GW_PrepSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_S5" sourceRef="GW_PrepSplit" targetRef="T_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_S6" sourceRef="GW_PrepSplit" targetRef="T_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_S7" sourceRef="T_PreparePayment" targetRef="End_PaymentPrepared"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_S8" sourceRef="T_PrepareShipment" targetRef="End_ShipmentPrepared"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_S9" sourceRef="SE_AddressPaymentDone" targetRef="T_CompleteOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_S10" sourceRef="T_CompleteOrder" targetRef="End_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
